channelDescription:
I help builders, creators, and tinkerers supercharge their workflows with AI and automation.

Over the past few years, I've been geeking-out implementing AI agents, no-code tools like Make.com and n8n, and other AI systems into my own 8-figure business - so I have a unique perspective of what actually works.

I’m obsessed with how these tools can turn ideas into realities. I’ve built projects that streamline everything from content creation to business processes.

On this channel, I break down the playbooks, tools, and strategies for mastering AI-driven automation and coding—from solo side hustles to scaling full-blown businesses. Sometimes we're wiring up workflows in Make.com & building agents in n8n... then we're back to vibe-coding our next SaaS unicorn with  AI-assisted coding

I like to go broad (the big-picture of AI) and deep (step-by-step tutorials and tactics). If you’re into automating the boring stuff, coding smarter, or building with dope tools, it's worth a sub!
